steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all listed cell lines, culture media, supplements, plates, transfection reagents, plasmids, thapsigargin stock, and equipment needed for the experiment.

steps.title: Culture SH‑SY5Y cells
steps.instruction: Grow SH‑SY5Y cells in DMEM (glucose 4.5 g/L) supplemented with 10 % FBS and 100 U/mL penicillin plus 100 µg/mL streptomycin at 37 °C in a 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Transfect SH‑SY5Y with G‑CEPIA1er
steps.instruction: When cells are ~80 % confluent in a 24‑well plate (≈3.0 × 10⁵ cells), add 200 ng pCMV‑G‑CEPIA1er to 63 µL Opti‑MEM, then add 3.2 µL Lipofectamine LTX and 0.6 µL Plus™ Transfect, mix and apply to the cells.

steps.title: Image SH‑SY5Y cells after 28 h
steps.instruction: Twenty‑eight hours post‑transfection, observe cells on an inverted fluorescence microscope (e.g., Olympus IX‑71‑22TFL/PH) using a 20× objective when the dish is ~95 % confluent and transfection efficiency is ~15 %; reduce DMEM volume if phenol red background is high; acquire images containing ~100 fluorescent cells each.

steps.title: Quantify fluorescence with ImageJ
steps.instruction: Open each tif image in ImageJ, split channels (Image > Color > Split Channels) and keep the Green channel; subtract background (Process > Subtract Background, rolling‑ball radius = 50.0 px); set threshold (Adjust > Threshold) to include only cell areas; set measurements (Analysis > Set Measurements, check “Mean grey Value” and “Limit to threshold”); run Measure (Analysis > Measure) to obtain mean grey values.

substeps.instruction: Split channels and retain Green channel.
Subtract background with rolling‑ball radius 50 px.
Apply threshold to isolate cell regions.
Set measurement options (Mean grey Value, limit to threshold).
Measure and record mean grey values.

steps.title: Statistical analysis in Excel
steps.instruction: Paste ImageJ results (e.g., A1:B17 and D1:E16) into Excel; compute the average of the reference group (cell B21); divide each value by this reference average (cells A25:B41 and D25:E40); calculate the mean (H26, I26) and standard deviation (H27, I27) of the normalized data; perform an F‑test (L26) to compare variances and a Student’s t‑test (L27) to assess significance.

substeps.instruction: Paste raw measurements into designated ranges.
Calculate reference group average.
Normalize each measurement by the reference average.
Compute group mean and standard deviation.
Run F‑test for variance equality.
Run Student’s t‑test for significance.

steps.title: Culture HCT116 cells
steps.instruction: Grow HCT116 cells in DMEM (glucose 4.5 g/L) with 10 % FBS and 100 U/mL penicillin plus 100 µg/mL streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Co‑transfect HCT116 with GCaMP6f and Seipin
steps.instruction: When cells are ~60 % confluent in a 6‑well plate (≈8.0 × 10⁵ cells), prepare a mixture of 1 µg pGP‑CMV‑GCaMP6f, 100 ng pCMV‑myc‑wtSeipin or pCMV‑myc‑ngSeipin, 300 µL Opti‑MEM, and 10 µL polyethylenimine max (1 mg/mL); add to cells and incubate.

steps.title: Image HCT116 cells after 28 h
steps.instruction: Twenty‑eight hours after co‑transfection, observe cells under the same inverted fluorescence microscope; if phenol red causes background, reduce DMEM volume; use a 20× objective when the dish is ~95 % confluent and transfection efficiency is 40‑50 %; acquire images containing ~150‑200 fluorescent cells each.

steps.title: Add thapsigargin to induce calcium release
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 mM thapsigargin stock in DMSO (store at –20 °C); add thapsigargin to the culture medium to a final concentration of 1 µM to inhibit SERCA and trigger ER calcium leakage.

steps.title: Acquire time‑course fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Record fluorescence images at 0 s, then every 30 s (or at 0, 60, 300 s) after thapsigargin addition, using the same microscope settings as before.

steps.title: Quantify cytoplasmic fluorescence with ImageJ
steps.instruction: Process the time‑course images using the identical ImageJ workflow described in step 4 (split channels, keep Green, subtract background with 50 px rolling ball, threshold, set measurements, measure).

substeps.instruction: Split channels and retain Green channel.
Subtract background (rolling‑ball radius 50 px).
Apply threshold to isolate cell regions.
Set measurement options (Mean grey Value, limit to threshold).
Measure and record mean grey values for each time point.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of cytoplasmic data
steps.instruction: Analyze the quantified data in Excel following the same procedure as step 5 (normalize to the 0 s control, compute means, SDs, perform F‑test and Student’s t‑test).

substeps.instruction: Paste measurements into Excel.
Normalize each time‑point value to the 0 s control.
Calculate mean and standard deviation for each condition.
Conduct F‑test for variance equality.
Conduct Student’s t‑test for significance.
